detection_opportunity: Temp python child with repeated uncommon-destination connections
logic: Remote-service child from temp path followed by repeated outbound connections.
expected_value: Detects payload execution and C2 after lateral movement.
false_positive_notes: Python is legitimate; parent/path/user/destination context required.

logic: Correlate suspicious service install with later LocalSystem process.
false_positive_notes: Installers create legitimate services; baseline publisher/path/installer.
